boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 142 is a keyhole tower that thins progressively from a dense upper body to a narrow stem, with a fixed `21` void marker locked in the center. Three directional arrow lanes — blue left, red right, purple down — are the only exits. The tower must shed weight from the top first; push the right-side cyan ring before the upper body thins and the `21` void stays buried under collapsing blocks.
landmarks: Block Out Level 142 is a keyhole tower that thins progressively from a dense upper body to a narrow stem, with a fixed `21` void marker locked in the center.
Three directional arrow lanes — blue left, red right, purple down — are the only exits.
The tower must shed weight from the top first; push the right-side cyan ring before the upper body thins and the `21` void stays buried under collapsing blocks.

quickTips: Open the blue left lane before touching the right orange stack.
The 21 void tile never moves — clear around it, not through it.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the top blue up-arrow cap and the red/yellow upper band without shifting the 21 void tile.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Feed upper scraps down the purple bottom-arrow lane to open the lower-left blue exit.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Peel the left purple/blue column through the blue left-arrow lane, leaving the void intact.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the right orange/yellow stack through the red right-arrow lane once the left side is open.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Break the cyan ring around the central yellow block in the mid-tower gap.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Slide the remaining blue and orange scraps off the lower base toward the bottom arrow.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Exit the final scattered blocks for the BLOCK OUT! clear.

failurePoints: Opening the right orange lane before the left blue lane thins, locking the mid-tower stack.
Trying to move the 21 void tile instead of clearing the blocks around it.
